title: Leonardo generateImage leaves the generation on the account on timeout, FAILED or download failure
body:
## Summary
generateImage deletes the Leonardo generation only on the success path; a poll timeout, a FAILED status or a failed image download leaves it on the account, breaking the download-then-delete contract.

## Description
src/lib/leonardo.ts:162 calls downloadThenDelete only after pollUntilReady resolves. pollUntilReady throws on timeout (src/lib/visual-gen/poll.ts:48) and on FAILED, and downloadThenDelete throws before deleteGeneration when the image fetch is not ok (src/lib/leonardo.ts:412). In all three cases generationId is known and never deleted; a generation that completes after the 60 s poll window (30 attempts x 2000 ms, src/lib/leonardo.ts:13-14) stays on the account with its image. Fixed looks like: a try/finally around poll + download that deletes generationId on every exit once it exists (generateVideoFromPrompt already has this shape at src/lib/leonardo.ts:388). src/lib/leonardo.ts belongs to no context in context-map.json, so it was outside this round's paths.

## Flow
- POST /api/leonardo mode image -> generateImage -> poll exceeds 30 attempts -> throws timeout
- the generation finishes on Leonardo later -> its image stays on the account, nothing ever deletes it
- fix: try/finally around poll + download that calls deleteGeneration(generationId) whenever cleanup !== false

## Expected impact
The operator account stops accumulating orphaned generations from slow or failed runs; measured by a stubbed-fetch test counting DELETE calls per failure exit. Could break: a caller that re-polls a timed-out generation by id (none in tree).

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - every Leonardo image generation is deleted on every exit path
Before: 3 failure exits (timeout, FAILED, download !ok) issue 0 DELETE calls (read of src/lib/leonardo.ts:136-163 and 410-416)
After: predicted 3 of 3 exits issue one DELETE /generations/{id}
Method: simulation - three exits walked in code; the stubbed-fetch test is S but the file is outside this round's context paths
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/lib/leonardo.ts:136-163 (poll, then downloadThenDelete only on success)
src/lib/leonardo.ts:410-416 (throws before deleteGeneration on !imgRes.ok)
src/lib/visual-gen/poll.ts:48 (throw opts.onTimeout())
src/lib/leonardo.ts:388 (finally { deleteGeneration } precedent)
instrument: vitest with stubbed global fetch: count DELETE /generations/<id> calls for timeout (maxAttempts reached), FAILED status, and image download 500

title: Upscale and unzoom create Leonardo jobs that nothing downloads or deletes
body:
## Summary
/api/leonardo modes upscale and unzoom start a Leonardo variation job and return only its id; no code polls, downloads or deletes the result, so every run leaves an asset on the account. Both also need a live generated-image id, which the cleanup contract has already deleted for every PoF generation.

## Description
src/app/api/leonardo/route.ts:63-75 returns { upscaleJobId } / { unzoomJobId } from src/lib/leonardo.ts:422-489; the only UI caller (src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/AdvancedTexturePanel/useAdvancedTexturePanel.ts:117-139) just displays the id. A grep for a variations poll/download/delete finds 0 hits. Second contradiction: both take a generatedImageId, but every PoF generation is deleted right after download, so the only ids that still exist were made outside PoF. Fixed looks like either a variation poll -> download -> delete flow that returns bytes (like generateImage), or removing the two modes and their panel controls. Choosing between them is a product call.

## Flow
- Material Lab -> Upscale with a typed image id -> POST /api/leonardo {mode: upscale}
- Leonardo creates the upscaled variation -> the route returns the job id -> the UI shows it
- nothing fetches the result; the variation stays on the account indefinitely

## Expected impact
Closes the last Leonardo paths that break download-then-delete: the operator either gets bytes back or the dead controls go. Could break: anyone using the job id by hand in the Leonardo web UI.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - every Leonardo asset PoF creates is downloaded, then deleted
Before: 2 of 4 route modes (upscale, unzoom) create provider assets with 0 download and 0 delete calls
After: unmeasured - depends on build-out vs removal
Method: simulation - read the route, the lib and the only UI caller; the direction has no figure
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
evidence:
src/app/api/leonardo/route.ts:63-75
src/lib/leonardo.ts:422-489 (returns job id only)
src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/AdvancedTexturePanel/useAdvancedTexturePanel.ts:117-139 (setJobId / setUzJob only)

title: multiview-to-3d submits skip the Tier-0 input gate on a paid Tripo task
body:
## Summary
POST /api/visual-gen/generate gates only mode image-to-3d; a multiview-to-3d submit (Tripo, paid) never runs the input gate, not even on its front view.

## Description
src/app/api/visual-gen/generate/route.ts:138 runs the gate only when mode === image-to-3d && imageDataUrl. Multiview carries viewDataUrls (route.ts:68) and is dispatched to startTripo multiview (src/lib/visual-gen/runner-dispatch.ts:144-155) with no inputGate on the 202. The route header (route.ts:39-41) says every image-to-3d submit passes the gate, which is literally true and leaves the multiview paid path ungated. Fixed looks like: gate viewDataUrls.front (one vision call) with the same refusal/override vocabulary. Whether side views are gated too is the open design question. No UI caller sends multiview today (grep src/components: 0), so the exposure is API / pof-mcp callers.

## Flow
- POST /generate {mode: multiview-to-3d, providerId: tripo3d, viewDataUrls: {front: cluttered.png}}
- no gate runs -> Tripo task created -> credits spent on an input the gate would fail
- fix: parseVisionImage(front) -> gateInputImage -> inputGateRefusal before dispatch.start

## Expected impact
A bad multiview front is refused before a Tripo task (20+ credits); measured by a route test with a stubbed gate. Could break: callers that relied on multiview being ungated (they add gateInput: false).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - every paid image-conditioned 3D submit passes the Tier-0 gate
Before: 1 of 2 image-conditioned modes gated (image-to-3d yes, multiview-to-3d no)
After: predicted 2 of 2
Method: simulation - route read; the route test is S, but deciding which views to gate makes it more than a mechanical fix
Result: better
Gate: policy-tighten
instrument: route test mocking gateInputImage to fail: a multiview submit returns 400 before RUNNER_DISPATCH.tripo3d.start is called

title: generateBestOf param sweep has zero production callers
body:
## Summary
best-of-n.ts exports generateBestOf (the TripoSR parameter sweep) and its GenCandidate / BestOfResult / Variant types, and nothing outside tests calls them.

## Description
A grep for generateBestOf over src/ and scripts/ outside __tests__ finds 0 consumers; the only best-of-n importer is src/lib/visual-gen/tripo-job-store.ts:15, which uses generateUntilAcceptable. docs/research/impact-map.md:78 records the sweep as MARGINAL (near-tie CLIP 0.9676-0.9704) because TripoSR is deterministic. The context-map description still advertises best-of-n as running parallel generations and auto-selecting the highest quality: the code is sequential and that selection path is unused. Removing it (src/lib/visual-gen/best-of-n.ts:90-128 plus its cases in src/__tests__/lib/visual-gen/best-of-n.test.ts) also needs a note in the research doc and the context-map description, both director-owned.

## Flow
- grep -rn generateBestOf src scripts -> only best-of-n.ts and its test
- delete the function and its types; keep scoreBreakdown/combinedScore (used by generateUntilAcceptable)
- update the context-map description and the research doc line (director)

## Expected impact
About 40 fewer lines in a cost-bearing module and one less capability claim with nothing behind it; could break nothing in tree (0 callers).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - no exported capability without a caller
Before: 1 exported function + 3 exported types with 0 production consumers
After: 0
Method: probe - zero-consumer grep run this round
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
grep generateBestOf: src/lib/visual-gen/best-of-n.ts:99 only (plus its test)
src/lib/visual-gen/tripo-job-store.ts:15 imports generateUntilAcceptable only
instrument: grep -rn "generateBestOf|BestOfResult" over src and scripts excluding __tests__ (expect 0 after) + best-of-n.test.ts green

title: One corrupt JSON row 500s the whole Style DNA and material lists
body:
## Summary
style-dna-db toProfile and material-db rowToRecord JSON.parse each row unguarded, while asset-library-db rowToAsset guards the same shape; one bad row throws on every list or active read.

## Description
src/lib/visual-gen/style-dna-db.ts:56 JSON.parse(r.dna) inside toProfile is reached by getActiveStyleDna, which every applyStyleDna generation calls (src/lib/visual-gen/style-apply.ts:66 via styleDnaForProfile), so a corrupt active row turns each styled generation into a 500. src/lib/visual-gen/material-db.ts:68 does the same for listMaterials. The twin src/lib/visual-gen/asset-library-db.ts:226-232 catches and degrades. Writers only JSON.stringify, so corruption needs a manual edit or a partial write: low likelihood, wide blast radius. Fixed looks like: skip (list) or null (get) with a logged reason.

## Flow
- a style_dna row's dna becomes '{' (manual edit / bad migration)
- POST /api/leonardo {applyStyleDna: true} -> getActiveStyleDna -> JSON.parse throws -> 500
- GET /api/visual-gen/style-dna -> 500, so the editor cannot even show the bad row to delete it

## Expected impact
A bad row degrades to skipped-and-logged instead of taking down styled generation and the editor; could break a test that expects a throw (none found).

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - one malformed row does not fail every read
Before: 2 of 3 row decoders in this context unguarded (style-dna-db, material-db); 1 guarded (asset-library-db)
After: predicted 3 of 3 guarded
Method: simulation - three decoders read; a :memory: test seeding one bad row is S
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: :memory: DB test: insert a row with dna '{', then listStyleDna / getActiveStyleDna do not throw and report the row as skipped

title: One relative ambientCG download link throws away the whole search page
body:
## Summary
ambientCgVariants calls new URL(d.downloadLink) with no base, so a single relative or malformed link throws and searchAmbientCG fails for the whole result page.

## Description
src/lib/visual-gen/download-variants.ts:83 evaluates new URL(d.downloadLink) when fileName is absent; a relative link throws TypeError inside the map at src/lib/visual-gen/asset-sources.ts:161, so the browse route fails for all 20 rows. Fixed looks like: new URL(link, 'https://ambientcg.com') inside a try, or skip that one variant.

## Flow
- ambientCG returns one row whose download has no fileName and a relative downloadLink
- ambientCgVariants -> new URL(relative) -> TypeError
- searchAmbientCG rejects -> the browser shows an error instead of 19 good rows

## Expected impact
One odd upstream row costs one variant, not the page; could break nothing (pure function).

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - a malformed upstream row is isolated
Before: 1 bad row -> 0 of N rows returned (simulated)
After: predicted N-1 rows, the bad variant skipped
Method: simulation - code read; whether ambientCG actually emits relative links is unverified (no network this round)
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: unit test: ambientCgVariants on a fixture with one relative downloadLink and no fileName returns the other variants without throwing
